body:
Thanks for listing your workaround/solution. It looks solid! We have couple options in mind on how to solve this fundamentally, but not yet sure how it can be done with minimal breaking changes. One idea we had is to use ui state (see https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/discussions/4826) as a source of truth, as this aligns more with how the UI, URL etc. looks, but would require further logic in each widget to decide how to flatten or display the UI state.

You could have a part of that solution, which would be robust. You intercept the numeric refinement as you already do, but as the `refine` function, you can override it with `search.setUiState` for that relevant widget. That would allow you to call only one function.
